what: the shore at Castlepoint, Wairarapa coast: public coastal land beside the scenic reserve

answer.label: Ground heights around the point (LINZ 1 m LiDAR)
answer.cadence: as LINZ adds surveys to the national 1 m model
answer.unit: m above NZVD2016 at the point

point.crs: EPSG:2193 (NZGD2000 / NZTM2000); the latitude and longitude are taken as NZGD2000, which is within about a metre of WGS84

heightAtPoint.method: bilinear between the four nearest 1 m cell centres

values.what: bare ground with buildings and plants taken off

verticalDatum.name: New Zealand Vertical Datum 2016 (NZVD2016)
verticalDatum.statedBy: LINZ elevation TIFF specification (the files record only NZTM2000)

survey.title: Wellington LiDAR 1m DEM (2013-2014)
survey.identified: the only survey LINZ lists for this map tile

accuracy.stored: LINZ stores each height to within 1 mm of the supplied value (LERC, MAX_Z_ERROR 0.001); this answer rounds to 1 cm
accuracy.survey: LINZ describes these LiDAR datasets as generally about 20 cm vertical accuracy

heights.encoding: base64 of little-endian uint16, row by row from the north-west cell

source.name: Toitū Te Whenua LINZ, New Zealand Elevation open data (Registry of Open Data on AWS)

licence.name: CC BY 4.0 (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International)
licence.attribution: Sourced from Toitū Te Whenua LINZ and licensed by Greater Wellington Regional Council, for re-use under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence.

answer.note: Heights are LINZ's own 1 m cells, not resampled: bare ground with buildings and plants taken off. They are a survey from the air, not a site survey by a licensed surveyor. Levels are in NZVD2016, which is not the same as a council's older local datum.
answer.limits: One square of up to 321 m by 321 m per request. Only the national 1 m LiDAR model is read; land LINZ has not flown at 1 m answers unavailable.
